name: tres-fort
description: Use your Très Fort training plan and workout history in your AI app.

interface.shortDescription: Plan training with your workout history.
interface.longDescription: Connect your Très Fort account to review training, adapt workouts and save plan changes. Conversations stay in your AI app. Uses your existing supported AI account or subscription; Très Fort does not supply model usage.
defaultPrompt: Review my recent training and suggest next week’s workouts.
What is planned for today, and how did my last workout go?
Help me adapt my training around an upcoming trip.
